title: Archived week of parlays (R73)
description: One file per (season, week) under data/parlays/<season>_wk<NN>.json, written by scripts/build_parlay_archive.py: data/parlays.json VERBATIM (season, week, updated_utc, parlays - the same leg contract as parlays.schema.json, implied_prob display-only) plus archived_utc, closed and history. Created on first sight of the week, refreshed on every run while the week is open (the last priced state before close; as-made prices live in the R58 leg ledger), and NEVER rewritten once closed = every game of the week FINAL in schedule_full.json. Validated by scripts/validate_data.py (optional directory).

game_id.description: Present for scope='game' parlays; the game they attach to.

selection.description: The specific pick within the market.

side.description: Team side within the leg's event, preserved for correlation. Optional for legacy archives.

implied_prob.description: DISPLAY ONLY market column: the book's de-vigged probability for this exact selection when a real price was fetched, otherwise model_prob re-vigged by the standard hold (no book price exists for that leg). Never an input to anything we produce.

model_prob.description: OUR probability for this leg, computed without any market price (owner policy: market prices are display only). Moneyline = the game model's win probability; spread = exactly 0.5 at the book's handicap since R51 (the cover model measured below coin-flip on 2023-25 - see edge_note); props = the calibrated logistic on this week's projected yards (or the labelled seed fallback). A market's de-vigged probability may never appear here - a market with no model of ours yields no leg at all.

edge_note.description: Spread legs only (R51): states that the cover model measured no edge and the leg is priced flat at 0.5 until a margin model clears never-regress.

pricing.description: Prop legs only: 'calibrated' = sigmoid(a + b*z + c*(p_team-0.5)) with coefficients from data/parlay_backtest.json; 'seed' = the pre-R51 fallback (calibration file absent or position uncovered), always paired with estimate_note.

estimate.description: Prop legs: the line is a documented seed threshold, not a book line.

estimate_note.description: Prop legs priced by the seed fallback carry this note so the fallback is never silent.

mu.description: Prop legs: the player's projected yards this week (season component x weekly share).

sd.description: Prop legs (calibrated): residual sd of yards for the position, from data/parlay_backtest.json.

line.description: Prop legs: the yardage line the leg is evaluated at.

gsis_id.description: R77: prop legs, the player the leg is priced on (mirrors parlays.schema.json; the open week's archive is a verbatim copy of parlays.json).

availability.description: R77: the one non-ACTIVE status a leg is priced WITH (mirrors parlays.schema.json).

model_ev.description: Model expected value of the parlay (edge vs implied odds).

confidence_tier.description: Ordinal band from a HARD-CODED edge threshold, not a calibration: high >= 0.12, medium >= 0.04 on (combined model_prob - combined implied_prob) minus 0.01 per leg beyond two. Nothing about it is calibrated and it states NO coverage guarantee - scripts/harness/conformal.py plays no part in producing it. Read it as a ranking, never as a probability of covering.

correlation_note.description: How leg correlation was handled (required, may be 'independent legs').

archived_utc.description: UTC stamp of the last write of this file (creation, a refresh while open, or the close).

closed.description: true once every game of the week carries a FINAL status in data/schedule_full.json (scripts.scrape.espn.FINAL_STATUSES). A closed file is never rewritten.

history.description: One entry per DISTINCT parlays.json updated_utc this archive saw for the week, in the order seen; archived_utc is the run that first saw it.
